user.title: Connect SMPLwise Dry Contact
user.description: Enter the controller IP. Digital inputs and supported expansion cards are detected automatically. The controller must use Modbus TCP server mode. Advanced defaults: port 502, Modbus address 1.

reconfigure.title: Change controller connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new connection details for the same controller. Existing entity IDs are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the controller. Check the IP, port, Modbus address, TCP server mode, network protocol (Modbus TCP) and IO bus health.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address, without http:// or a port.
error.unsupported_model: Cannot determine the digital input count for this model or IO inventory. Check that this is an M31-U. You can enter the total input count in the advanced fields.

abort.wrong_device: This IP belongs to a different controller (MAC address mismatch).

init.title: Digital input options
init.description: 0 inputs uses automatic detection. To override it, enter the total number of DI inputs across the host and all expansion cards. Inverted inputs are numbered from 1; separate numbers with commas, for example 1, 3, 16.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the controller. Check the connection and IO bus health.
error.unsupported_model: Cannot detect inputs. Enter an explicit total input count.
error.invalid_inputs: Use comma-separated input numbers between 1 and the total detected input count.
